newsitem.title: USA: Fed expected to add reserves via term system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed expected to add reserves via term system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is likely to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Thursday through multi-day system repurchase agreements, analysts said.

"We think they'll do either five- or seven-day (fixed) system RPs," said Michael Moran, chief economist at Daiwa Securities America Inc. "Our numbers are showing a sizable need to get funds into the banking system -- about $7.0 billion a day and I don't think they would want to fall behind on an add need of that size."

"We expect the Fed to intervene with seven-day fixed system repos," said analysts at MMS International. "We project about a $5 billion to $6 billion add need for the period and expect the desk to try to address most of this week's add with term rps."
Federal funds were quoted at 5-1/4 percent, the Fed's target for the rate, in morning trade.
